convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to use MOLE mixed expert linear layers with configurable expert count and SO2 layer types
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear module with a MOLE or MOLEDGL mixed expert layer using global tensors and caching
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all linear layers inside SO2_Convolution modules with a given replacement factory function
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace every nn.Linear module in a model tree with a given replacement factory function
model_search_and_replace: search model blocks by index and apply a recursive module replacement function to specified layers
